name: Infernal Realm
description: The supernatural realm embodying evil, the sum of all opposition to the needs of individuals; it is parasitic on divine light and gains power from human sin.

name: Divine Realm
description: The realm of God, opposed by the Infernal; beings affiliated with it feel disgust within Infernal auras.

name: Magic Realm
description: Supernatural realm whose creatures recognize Infernal auras as false promises and are especially at risk from their deceptions.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Supernatural realm of amoral fae who are terrified by the inhuman evil of the Infernal; Faerie powers are weak in Infernal auras.

name: Dominion
description: The Divine aura protecting the homes of God's people; it erodes weaker Infernal auras and flows to fill the void on Good Friday.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting of Ars Magica, where magic is real and demons work to corrupt all people.

name: Hell
description: The place of punishment for demons and damned souls, the aspect of the Infernal realm hidden in the dark abysses of the earth.

name: Gehenna
description: Scriptural term for Hell as a place of hell-fire and brimstone and eternal torment; named after the Vale of Hinnom.

name: Sheol
description: Scriptural place of eternal darkness where the dead are deprived of Heaven rather than physically punished; also a Jewish degree of Hell.

name: Limbo of Infants
description: Part of Hell holding those who die in original sin alone, without personal mortal sin.

name: Limbo of the Fathers
description: Part of Hell where the souls of the just who died before Christ awaited Heaven; emptied by the Harrowing of Hell.

name: Purgatory
description: Where the souls of the just who died in venial sin are cleansed by suffering before admission to Heaven.

name: Harrowing of Hell
description: The common belief that Jesus descended into Hell before his resurrection and liberated the limbo of the Fathers.

name: Heaven
description: God's abode, from which Hell is as remote as possible; the Eastern Church holds Hell and Heaven to be the same place.

name: Gates of Hell
description: The entrance to Hell, guarded and rated as an Infernal aura of 9; some regiones are said to reach them.

name: Sitra Achra
description: Kabbalist term for the other side of Creation, the Infernal realm, ruled by the Princes of Evil; demons are born of it when man sins.

name: Qlippot
description: The ten unholy spheres composing the Infernal realm in Kabbalah, perversions of the ten holy sefirot.

name: Sefirot
description: The ten holy spheres governing God's creation in Kabbalist thought, perverted by the qlippot.

name: Princes of Evil
description: Rulers of the sitra achra, the Infernal realm, in Kabbalist writings.

name: Moral Evil
description: An act of free will against the moral order prescribed by God; the only kind of evil that constitutes sin.

name: Physical Evil
description: Evil that deprives a subject of some natural good, such as sickness, death, poverty, and oppression; attributed to demons by Divine religions.

name: Metaphysical Evil
description: Limitations or privations imposed by one's own nature; magic seeks to overcome it, which may explain the Church's wariness of magic.

name: The Gift
description: The magical talent of magi; some Christian magi argue its privation in mundanes is metaphysical evil.

name: Infernal Aura
description: Regions of distilled evil emanating from the Infernal realm, rated 1–10, increasing at night and on unholy days and eroded by stronger auras.

name: Corruption Roll
description: Storyguide roll (stress die + temporary Infernal aura) made after a major sin to maintain or increase an Infernal aura.

name: Corruption Rite
description: Rites learned via Infernal Lore that formalize a mortal sin to allow a corruption roll, usually with candles, profane names, obscene acts and sacrifice.

name: Tarnished Aura
description: An Infernal aura bearing a resonance for a particular sin, represented as a sinful Personality Trait affecting all within it.

name: Corrupted Aura
description: A permanently tarnished Infernal aura of at least 3 with corrupting effects beyond its tarnish; divided into Debauched, Malevolent and Perfidious.

name: Debauched Aura
description: A corrupted aura arising from self-indulgence, tarnished with Sloth, Lust or Gluttony and seductive to mundanes.

name: Malevolent Aura
description: A corrupted aura of sentient cruelty tarnished with sins of violence and perverted appetite, adding its strength to damage and botches.

name: Perfidious Aura
description: A corrupted aura embodying sins that betray trust, such as treachery and hypocrisy, typically found within the Dominion.

name: Infernal Regio
description: Antechambers of Hell consigned to the Infernal by God, where Divine powers are suspended and no pleasure can be felt.

name: Tartaran Regio
description: Infernal regio reflecting the torment of Hell, filled with fuel-less hellfire whose damage increases with the victim's sinful traits.

name: Abyssal Regio
description: Infernal regio of privation from God that reduces all Characteristics and can inflict madness Flaws.

name: Devouring Regio
description: Rumored roaming Infernal regiones attracted to evil souls that swallow people and may deliver them to Hell.

name: Regio
description: A layered supernatural area; Infernal versions are discussed as manifestations of the Infernal realm.

name: Infernal Warping
description: Warping caused primarily by sin or Infernal sources, producing Flaws that encourage sinful behavior and later Infernal Virtues.

name: Warping Point
description: Points accumulating from supernatural exposure; gained from ritualized sin, strong Infernal auras, powerful Infernal Powers and botches.

name: Infernal Vis
description: Vis tainted by Hell's power, undetectable by Hermetic magic, in three types of increasing danger; imposes sinful Personality Traits.

name: Vis
description: Magical raw power in flavors corresponding to the Hermetic Arts; can be tainted by the Infernal.

name: Vis Infesta
description: The least dangerous Infernal vis, formed when vis lies a year in an Infernal aura or from minor demons; botches are more severe.

name: Vis Sordida
description: The most common Infernal vis, manifesting in Infernal auras; adds +5 per pawn but three extra botch dice per pawn and corrupts enchantments.

name: Vis Prava
description: The most vile Infernal vis, found in strong Infernal auras or powerful demons; any roll using it is automatically a zero for non-Infernal users.

name: Sin
description: An act that assists the Infernal or does not serve God, staining the soul; divided into mortal (major) and venial (minor) sins.

name: Seven Deadly Sins
description: Model of vices (Proud, Wrathful, Envious, Slothful, Lustful, Greedy, Avaricious) used to categorize Personality Traits with opposing virtues.

name: Redemption
description: A sinner may always escape Hell by truly repenting, via confession and penance or ritual fasts of atonement.

name: Infernal Influence
description: The ability of infernalists to inspire sinful Personality Traits in others via personal or ceremonial influence (simple die + Presence + Leadership).

name: Confidence
description: Points of self-worth and resolve; sinners gain them by indulging or ritualizing sins, at the cost of Warping for ritual acts.

name: Personality Trait
description: Traits describing a character's habits and inclinations, used to model sinful and virtuous tendencies and affected by tarnish.

name: Deals with the Devil
description: Pacts with demons sealed by oath or contract, often with curses to deter repentance; demons often cheat the supplicant.

name: Infernalist
description: Characters associated with the Infernal who pursue corruption, can learn corruption rites and exert infernal influence.

name: Demon
description: Agents of the Infernal who corrupt humanity, torment the damned, and walk the earth by God's permission; in Jewish lore born of Lilith and Adam.

name: Avengers of Evil
description: A type of demon sometimes posited to have Divine status as agents of punishment.

name: Accusers
description: A type of demon sometimes posited to have Divine status.

name: Satanim
description: A group of angels ruled by Satan in Jewish belief, assisting him in opposing man.

name: Corrupted Beasts
description: Creatures corrupted by living in Infernal auras; their corpses commonly yield vis infesta.

name: Envisioning Power
description: Common demonic Power used to create delusions to haunt visitors of Infernal auras.

name: Obsession Power
description: Common demonic Power inflicting powerful obsessions; determines the trait imposed by vis from a demon's corpse.

name: The Devil
description: The personification of evil, understood differently by Jews, Christians and Muslims; master of infernalists.

name: Satan
description: In Judaism, the angel charged by God with accusing and testing man, chief of the satanim; Christians use the name for their archfiend.

name: Sammael
description: In Jewish demonology the personification of evil and true Devil, who sent the serpent to tempt Eve; husband of Lilith.

name: Lilith
description: In Jewish lore Adam's first wife, who fled Eden, became a wife of Sammael and bore Adam demon children daily.

name: Iblis
description: The Islamic Devil, who refused to bow to Adam and tempted him with the tree of immortality.

name: Adam
description: The first man, tempted by Shaitan and cast from Eden; father of demons by Lilith in Jewish lore.

name: Eve
description: Tempted by Sammael's serpent in the Garden of Eden, the first sin.

name: Garden of Eden
description: The garden from which Adam and Eve were cast out after the first sin.

name: Molech
description: A false god worshiped with child sacrifice in the Vale of Hinnom, associated with the demon Adramelech.

name: Judas Iscariot
description: Betrayer of Christ who hanged himself at Aceldama; his conspiracy is why Infernal auras rise the Wednesday before Easter.

name: Jesus
description: Harrowed Hell before his resurrection; Good Friday reduces all Infernal auras to zero.

name: Moses
description: Prophet Satan tried to kill; opposed Egyptian sorcerers aided by Satan.

name: Aaron
description: With Moses, contested the Egyptian sorcerers helped by Satan.

name: Josiah
description: Prophet who rendered the Vale of Hinnom ceremonially unclean, ending child sacrifice there.

name: Mohammad
description: Prophet to whom the Qur'an was communicated, commemorated on the Night of Destiny.

name: St. Augustine
description: Theologian quoted on God bringing good out of evil.

name: Aristotle
description: Philosopher who held evil to be a necessary aspect of the changes of matter with no real existence.

name: Pythagoras
description: Greek philosopher cited for rational conceptions of evil inherent in matter.

name: Empedocles
description: Greek philosopher cited for conceptions of evil inherent in matter.

name: Heraclitus
description: Greek philosopher cited for conceptions of evil inherent in matter.

name: Marie de France
description: Translated the Purgatory of St. Patrick into the vernacular in the late 12th century.

name: Espurgatoire seint Patritz
description: A widely circulated tract describing a knight's vision of the torments of Hell.

name: Qur'an
description: Islamic scripture, quoted on Shaitan and Iblis; its revelation is commemorated on the Night of Destiny.

name: Kabbalists
description: Jewish mystics who wrote that God limited his power in creation, defining the sitra achra.

name: Zoroastrianism
description: Oldest Divine religion, holding good and evil equal in power though good will triumph.

name: Gnostics
description: Dualist tradition viewing the material world as an instrument of evil.

name: Manichees
description: Dualist sect, succeeded by the Bogomils and Cathars.

name: Bogomils
description: Dualist successors of the Manichees.

name: Cathars
description: Dualist successors of the Manichees.

name: Waldensians
description: Heretics persecuted for teaching that sacraments from wicked priests were void, a belief encouraged by demons.

name: Church
description: The Christian Church, wary of magic and which administers confession and penance.

name: Eastern Church
description: Holds that Hell is the same place as Heaven, experienced as torment or pleasure by disposition.

name: Rabbinical Judaism
description: Holds Hell has seven degrees and that angels cannot sin, so the Devil is a servant of God.

name: Islam
description: Holds Hell has seven gates and houses segregating souls by belief; the Devil rebelled at man's creation.

name: Ladha
description: Islamic degree of Hell for Christians.

name: Hothama
description: Islamic degree of Hell for Jews.

name: Saïr
description: Islamic degree of Hell for Sabians.

name: Sacar
description: Islamic degree of Hell for Zoroastrians.

name: Gehin
description: Islamic degree of Hell for idolaters and pagans.

name: Haoviath
description: Seventh and deepest Islamic degree of Hell, for hypocrites.

name: Abaddon
description: Jewish degree of Hell called Perdition.

name: Titahion
description: Jewish degree of Hell, the Filthy Mire.

name: Bar Shasketh
description: Jewish degree of Hell, the Pit of Destruction.

name: Tzelmoth
description: Jewish degree of Hell, the Shadow of Death.

name: Shaari Moth
description: Jewish degree of Hell, the Gates of Death.

name: Walpurgisnacht
description: April 30th in German lands, when witches gather to worship their master; an unholy night strengthening Infernal auras.

name: Allhallow's Eve
description: Night when demons, witches and ghosts roam the earth, strengthening Infernal auras.

name: Shabbat
description: Jewish sabbath; Infernal auras in observant Jewish communities decline by one.

name: Good Friday
description: At dusk all Infernal auras drop to zero until Easter Monday.

name: Night of Destiny
description: 27th of Ramadan, when all Infernal auras drop to zero until dawn.

name: Ramadan
description: Islamic month of fasting during which Infernal auras are reduced by two after the Night of Destiny.

name: Interdict
description: Church sanction; Infernal auras in regions under Interdict increase by 1.

name: Authorities
description: Angelic choir regulating Creation; Infernal regiones form where they no longer visit.

name: True Faith
description: Divine faith granting Magic Resistance and immunity to extra effects of Infernal auras.

name: Aceldama
description: Field in the Vale of Hinnom where Judas hanged himself; Infernal aura 8 and portal to the highest regio level.

name: Vale of Hinnom
description: Valley by Jerusalem once used for child sacrifice to Molech; a powerful Tartaran regio with temples to the Devil.

name: Jerusalem
description: City whose cesspool is the Vale of Hinnom.

name: Kidron
description: River carrying Jerusalem's sewage from Hinnom.

name: Das Goldene Kalb
description: Upmarket tavern and brothel in Lübeck owned by a Jerbiton magus, with an Infernal aura 3 tarnished with Lust.

name: Lübeck
description: Town in northern Germany, location of Das Goldene Kalb.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House; a member owns Das Goldene Kalb.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigators kept away from Das Goldene Kalb.

name: Liddesdale
description: Valley in the Scottish Borders with a Malevolent Infernal aura 3 tarnished with Fear.

name: Liddeswater
description: Small river running through Liddesdale.

name: Hermitage Castle
description: Castle in Liddesdale built on monks' bones, home of Lord David de Soulis.

name: David de Soulis
description: Hereditary seneschal of Scotland rumored to ride with demon dogs seeking souls for his demonic master.

name: Robyn Redcap
description: The familiar of David de Soulis.

name: Ossuary of St Helix
description: Crypt corrupted into a Perfidious Infernal aura 4 tarnished with hypocrisy, used by Father Theophagus to summon demons.

name: Father Theophagus
description: Priest of St Helix who decorates the church with bones and secretly summons demons in his crypt.

name: Carolus of Tytalus
description: Example magus who unwittingly opens an item with vis sordida.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House of Carolus.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The magi's order, in which Infernal vis is not commonly known.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Protective ritual around covenants beyond which Infernal evil lurks.

name: Heat of the Searing Forge
description: Creo Ignem spell whose effects apply to metal-carrying characters in Tartaran regiones.

name: Wreaths of Foul Smoke
description: Creo Auram spell whose effects match the poisonous smoke atop the Vale of Hinnom regio.

name: Demon's Eternal Oblivion
description: Spell that slays demons leaving no corpse, hence no Infernal vis.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Technique referenced in Creo Ignem and Creo Auram spells.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form of fire.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Form of air.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form; Vim vis extracted from Infernal auras is vis prava.

name: Infernal Lore
description: Ability giving knowledge of the Infernal, needed to learn corruption rites and ceremonial influence and recognize Infernal vis.

name: Magic Theory
description: Used with Perception to notice fatigue lost to Infernal aura penalties.

name: Leadership
description: Used with Presence for infernal influence and tarnishing auras.

name: Dodge
description: Only defense available to characters stunned in a Perfidious aura.

name: Inspirational
description: Virtue allowing ceremonial influence of strangers.

name: Temporal Influence
description: Virtue making the character trusted by those within his authority.

name: Enticer of Multitudes
description: Infernal Minor Supernatural Virtue gained at Warping Score 5.

name: Infernal Protection
description: Infernal Minor Supernatural Virtue gained at Warping Score 5.

name: Gender Shift
description: Infernal Minor Supernatural Virtue gained at Warping Score 5.

name: Aptitude for (Sin)
description: Infernal Minor Supernatural Virtue gained at Warping Score 5.

name: Infernal Blessings
description: Infernal Minor Supernatural Virtue gained at Warping Score 5.

name: Low Self-Esteem
description: Flaw for characters without Confidence; Theophagus acquires it temporarily.

name: Compulsion
description: Madness Flaw from Abyssal regiones and Infernal Warping.

name: Delusion
description: Madness Flaw from Abyssal regiones and Infernal Warping.

name: Depressed
description: Madness Flaw from Abyssal regiones.

name: Fear
description: Madness Flaw from Abyssal regiones.

name: Obsessed
description: Madness Flaw from Abyssal regiones and Infernal Warping.

name: Prohibition
description: Madness Flaw from Abyssal regiones.

name: Simple-Minded
description: Madness Flaw from Abyssal regiones.

name: Weak-Willed
description: Madness Flaw from Abyssal regiones; also acquired by venial sinners through Warping.

name: Avaricious
description: Personality Flaw suited to Infernal Warping.

name: Envious
description: Personality Flaw suited to Infernal Warping.

name: Greedy
description: Personality Flaw suited to Infernal Warping.

name: Hatred
description: Personality Flaw suited to Infernal Warping.

name: Lecherous
description: Personality Flaw suited to Infernal Warping.

name: Proud
description: Personality Flaw suited to Infernal Warping.

name: Wrathful
description: Personality Flaw suited to Infernal Warping.

name: Offensive to Animals
description: Acquired at Warping Score 3 when Warping comes mainly from venial sin.

name: Tainted with Evil
description: Acquired at Warping Score 3 when Warping comes from mortal sin or Infernal traffic.

name: Age Quickly
description: Common penalty at Infernal Warping Score 6+.

name: Enfeebled
description: Common penalty at Infernal Warping Score 6+.

name: Plagued by a Demon
description: Flaw when a demon is sent to prevent repentance at Warping 6+.

name: Vituperation
description: Infernalist phenomenon possibly manifesting as Devouring regiones.

name: Sacrifice
description: Infernal practice granting bonuses to corruption rolls, e.g. a black goat.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance granted passively by True Faith, still active in Infernal regiones.

name: Experimentation
description: Lab rules invoked when enchanting with Infernal vis, with storyguide choosing the worst result.

name: Luciferans
description: Misguided Infernal tradition.

name: Strigae
description: Misguided Infernal tradition.

name: Witch-Hammers
description: Misguided Infernal tradition.

name: Dark Gnostics
description: Corrupt Infernal tradition.

name: Dread Host
description: Corrupt Infernal tradition.

name: Mulhidun
description: Corrupt Infernal tradition.

name: Damhadh-Duidsan
description: Hermetic Infernal tradition.

name: Ordo Vagorum
description: Hermetic Infernal tradition.

name: Witches of Thessaly
description: Hermetic Infernal tradition.

name: Venatores
description: Demon-hunters.

name: Maleficia
description: Infernal methods and powers: Debauchery, Incantation, Consumption, Diablerie, Effusion, Malediction, Phantasm, Psychomachia.

name: Ars Goetia
description: Goetic arts of Summoning, Ablating, Binding and Commanding.

name: Summoning
description: Goetic Art.

name: Ablating
description: Goetic Art.

name: Binding
description: Goetic Art.

name: Commanding
description: Goetic Art.

name: Diabolist
description: Mythic Companion of the Maleficia.

name: Summoner
description: Mythic Companion of Ars Goetia.

name: Devil Child
description: Mythic Companion with demonic blood.

name: Mythic Companion
description: Powerful companion character type.

name: Tainted Characters
description: Characters tainted at birth by the Infernal.

name: False Gods
description: Order of the Infernal hierarchy.

name: Spirits of Deceit
description: Order of the Infernal hierarchy.

name: Vessels of Iniquity
description: Order of the Infernal hierarchy.

name: Deluders
description: Order of the Infernal hierarchy.

name: Aerial Powers
description: Order of the Infernal hierarchy.

name: Furies
description: Order of the Infernal hierarchy.

name: Tempters
description: Order of the Infernal hierarchy.

name: True Names
description: Demonic trait.

name: Apotropaic Spells
description: Protective Black Magic.

name: Infernal Magic
description: Black magic types.

name: Hermetic Arts
description: The Arts of magi; vis flavors correspond to them.
